_doc: Canonical arch-id / SKU alias map. The bare sm_120 deployment token selects the active RTX PRO 6000 Workstation card in the Python loader; historical RTX 5060-laptop data requires sm_120-laptop or its explicit SKU. Build-only tokens (sm_90a, sm_120a, sm_120f, sm_100a) remain compile-time vocabulary and are not deploy identities.
_rejected_doc: Uncaptured server/datacenter SKUs remain rejected. The RTX PRO 6000 Workstation Edition has a dedicated card and must be named explicitly; a bare sm_120 or generic PRO 6000 string is not enough to select a SKU.
